lines: Don't leave me stranded on the Beach. Open sand makes every threat feel close.
A Beach sounds peaceful until you are alone on it with nowhere solid to retreat to.
I was waiting on the Beach wondering what was coming out of the water next.
If you go missing on a Beach, I get the waves, the wind, and no cover at all.
The sand gave me nowhere to hide and nowhere steady to stand.
I kept watching the waterline, hoping the next movement was you and not something worse.
Please do not leave me somewhere so open that every direction feels exposed.
The Beach looked calm, but calm does not help much when I am alone.
Every wave sounded closer once I realized you were gone.
I was standing between the sea and the open sand, wishing either one felt safe.
Don't leave me near the Deep Lukewarm Ocean. Deep water is still deep water even when it feels mild.
The Deep Lukewarm Ocean sounded gentler than it felt once I was alone beside it.
I was stranded near the Deep Lukewarm Ocean with too much water and too little certainty.
If you wander off by a Deep Lukewarm Ocean, I still have to worry about what is moving below.
That water looked calm enough to trick someone careless. I was trying not to be careless.
I kept staring past the surface, which only made me think about how far down it went.
Please do not leave me beside deep water just because it looks warm and harmless.
The air felt mild, but the ocean still felt too large.
Every ripple made me wonder what I could not see underneath it.
I was alone by deep water, trying not to let my thoughts sink with it.
Don't leave me beside the Deep Ocean. Looking into water that dark does nothing good for my nerves.
The Deep Ocean made every wave sound enormous once I realized you had stopped leading.
I waited by the Deep Ocean trying not to imagine what might be rising from below.
If you disappear near the Deep Ocean, all I am left with is open water and bad thoughts.
The water was so dark it felt like it could keep secrets forever.
I kept backing away from the edge, even when I was already far enough.
Please do not leave me beside water that looks like it has no bottom.
The Deep Ocean made the world feel too wide and too empty.
Every sound from the waves felt heavier than it should have.
I was alone with dark water, and my imagination did not stay kind.
Don't leave me by the Lukewarm Ocean. Calm water still hides problems underneath it.
The Lukewarm Ocean looked gentle right up until I had to wait beside it alone.
I stood near the Lukewarm Ocean wondering what was moving below the surface while you were gone.
If you wander off beside a Lukewarm Ocean, I still have to fear what I cannot see.
The water was pleasant enough to look at, which made it worse when I started worrying.
I kept watching the surface for shapes that were not there until they were.
Please do not leave me where calm waves can make danger look polite.
The Lukewarm Ocean was quiet, but not quiet enough to comfort me.
Every little splash made me turn my head.
I was alone beside calm water, trying to remember that calm does not mean safe.
Don't leave me by the Ocean. Open water gives me too many things to worry about.
The Ocean felt far too large once I realized I was standing there alone.
I waited beside the Ocean trying not to imagine what might surface while you were gone.
If you wander off near the Ocean, I am left with waves, wind, and no walls at all.
The horizon did not help. It only made everything feel farther away.
I kept watching the water because it felt wrong to look anywhere else.
Please do not leave me where the world opens up and gives me nowhere to shelter.
The Ocean made waiting feel small and exposed.
Every wave kept arriving, and none of them brought you back.
I was alone beside too much water, hoping you remembered where you left me.
Don't leave me by the River. Banks get slippery fast when I have to move in a hurry.
The River sounded peaceful until I was alone beside it waiting for you.
I stood near the River trying to watch the water and the shoreline at the same time.
If you wander off at a River, I am left with mud, current, and no clear advantage.
The current kept moving like it knew exactly where it was going. I did not.
I kept checking the bank, because one bad step would make everything worse.
Please do not leave me where the ground is slick and the water is faster than it looks.
The River made every route feel like it could turn muddy in a hurry.
I could hear the water, the grass, and every sound that was not you.
I was alone by the bank, hoping I would not have to move quickly.
Don't leave me on the Stony Shore. Wet stone and open water are a poor pair.
The Stony Shore gave me nowhere soft to stand and nowhere safe to retreat to.
I waited on the Stony Shore trying not to slip while I kept watch for you.
If you disappear on a Stony Shore, I am left on slick rocks listening to the water grow louder.
Every rock looked stable until I had to trust it.
I kept my feet careful, but my nerves were less cooperative.
Please do not leave me somewhere the shore itself feels like a hazard.
The waves made the stones shine, and that only made me trust them less.
I had water on one side, hard rock under me, and no sign of you anywhere.
I was balancing on slick stone, hoping nothing forced me to move fast.
Don't leave me near the Warm Ocean. Warm water still hides things I do not want to meet.
The Warm Ocean seemed pleasant until I had to watch it alone.
I waited by the Warm Ocean wondering what might rise from below while you were gone.
If you wander off beside a Warm Ocean, I am still left with open water and no cover.
The water looked inviting, which only made me wonder what else it was inviting.
I kept staring at the bright surface, trying not to think about what lived under it.
Please do not leave me somewhere that looks safe just because it is beautiful.
The Warm Ocean was too calm to trust and too open to ignore.
Every splash made me remember I was alone.
I was standing by warm water, but there was nothing warm about being left there.
